recipes.title: David's Roku + Denon Setup
recipes.summary: A complete two-room Roku and Denon configuration, based on the repository's existing example.
description: Room 1, Den Test, uses a Roku for navigation and playback, with a Denon receiver handling volume and mute. It includes Movie, Music, and Vinyl custom actions that invoke Denon Quick Select presets.

Room 2, Sunroom, uses Roku for navigation and playback and Denon for volume and mute in this snapshot. This is NOT yet the user's current Roku-centric Sunroom configuration; it is a prototype copied from the repository example.
Device IP addresses are included and will be replaced as part of any future full-recipe import. Review every endpoint and action before saving.
rooms: Room 1 — Den Test: Roku navigation, Denon volume/mute, three custom actions
Room 2 — Sunroom: Roku navigation, Denon volume/mute, two custom actions
custom_actions: Den Test: Movie → Roku Home, then Denon Quick Select 1
Den Test: Music → Roku Home, then Denon Quick Select 2
Den Test: Vinyl → Roku Home, then Denon Quick Select 3
Sunroom: Movie → Roku Home, then Denon Quick Select 1
Sunroom: Music → Roku Home, then Denon Quick Select 2
